name: V4Hook Starter
summary: A multi-pool Uniswap v4 reference hook that records swap and liquidity callback counts without changing swap deltas, fees, access, or settlement.

integration.standardSwapBehavior: Ordinary swaps can use empty or non-empty hook data. The hook records one beforeSwap and one afterSwap count for the PoolId, returns zero deltas and no fee override, and does not read router or user identity.

dedicatedRouter.purpose: The hook does not attribute payer, recipient, or beneficiary identity and does not require a product-specific settlement path.

hookData.emptyDataBehavior: Empty hook data is accepted. Non-empty hook data is also accepted and ignored.

officialUniversalRouter.notes: The callbacks do not require custom data, but no exact deployed Universal Router address, runtime, fork matrix, or wallet readback is supplied.

multihop.notes: The source does not restrict multihop settlement, but no exact router and route evidence is supplied.

quoteDiscovery.notes: The hook does not implement a quote interface and does not claim ALF compatibility.

finalAmountEvidence.notes: Local branch tests reconcile PoolSwapTest return deltas with final test-wallet balances in all four quadrants. The manifest remains untested until that proof has a public immutable URL.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeAddLiquidity
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Pinned BaseHook restricts the external callback to the immutable PoolManager. The implementation performs one PoolId-scoped counter increment and no external call.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: One storage counter increment, no loop, and no external call. No target-chain callback gas measurement is claimed.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeRemoveLiquidity
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Pinned BaseHook restricts the external callback to the immutable PoolManager. The implementation performs one PoolId-scoped counter increment and no external call.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: One storage counter increment, no loop, and no external call. No target-chain callback gas measurement is claimed.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Pinned BaseHook restricts the external callback to the immutable PoolManager. The implementation ignores sender and hook data, increments one counter, and returns a zero delta.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: One storage counter increment, no loop, and no external call. No target-chain callback gas measurement is claimed.

callbackSemantics.name: afterSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Pinned BaseHook restricts the external callback to the immutable PoolManager. The implementation ignores sender and hook data, increments one counter, and returns a zero delta.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: One storage counter increment, no loop, and no external call. No target-chain callback gas measurement is claimed.

security.authorityModel: The hook has no owner, administrator, upgrade path, or external operator. Its only immutable runtime binding is the PoolManager supplied to the constructor.
knownRisks: The repository is an unaudited starter and is not approved for real-value deployment.
Every enabled callback writes storage, so a constrained caller can fail closed on callback gas.
Any pool and any PoolManager sender can use the hook; the hook does not authenticate routers or user identity.
